user.title: Connect to your IQ Gateway
user.description: Choose Automatic to obtain a local gateway JWT using your Enphase login, or Manual to paste a token. Automatic requires the email and password each time you submit. Leave Remember credentials off to save only the JWT; turn it on to store your Enphase login in Home Assistant configuration for renewal. Stored credentials are included in Home Assistant backups. Accounts requiring MFA or browser sign-in should use Manual. A new or changed gateway certificate requires your trust confirmation before authentication.

trust_certificate.title: Trust this gateway
trust_certificate.description:
A certificate was detected at `{host}`. Its names are unverified claims: check the address and advertised serial against your gateway before trusting. Your JWT has not been sent to this certificate.

Advertised gateway serial: `{serial_hint}`

Certificate subject: `{subject}`

Certificate issuer: `{issuer}`

SHA-256 fingerprint: `{fingerprint}`

Confirm below to remember this certificate and authenticate over a connection pinned to it. A future certificate change will require confirmation again.

data.trust_certificate: I checked the gateway details and trust this certificate

gateway_serial.title: Identify the IQ Gateway
gateway_serial.description: The trusted local gateway did not provide a public serial number. Enter the 12-digit serial from its label or Enphase account. The JWT will be checked against the same pinned gateway before anything is saved.

error.invalid_auth: The gateway rejected the JWT. Check its expiry and gateway permissions.
error.permission_denied: This token does not have access to the required local endpoints.
error.certificate_error: The gateway TLS certificate could not be read. Check the address and local connection, then try again.
error.unsupported_modes: This gateway reports a different mode mapping. Controls are blocked pending compatibility review.
error.invalid_input: Check the gateway address and authentication fields. Automatic needs an email and password; Manual needs a gateway JWT on first setup.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read the local gateway. Check connectivity and gateway compatibility.
error.certificate_changed: The certificate changed or could not be pinned during validation. Enter the connection details again to detect and review the certificate. No replacement fingerprint was saved.
error.trust_required: Tick the confirmation only after you have checked and trust this gateway.
error.cloud_invalid_auth: Enphase rejected the sign-in request. Check the email and password. If browser verification is needed, choose Manual and enter a gateway token.
error.cloud_mfa_required: Enphase requires browser sign-in or additional verification. Choose Manual and obtain a token at https://entrez.enphaseenergy.com/. Keep MFA enabled.
error.cloud_cannot_connect: Could not connect securely to Enphase for a token. Check internet access and try again, or choose Manual.
error.cloud_token_error: Enphase did not return a current gateway JWT. Check the gateway serial and account access, or obtain a token manually.
error.invalid_serial: Enter the IQ Gateway serial as exactly 12 digits.

abort.wrong_gateway: The supplied connection belongs to a different IQ Gateway.
abort.trust_required: Detect the gateway certificate before confirming trust. Restart setup.
abort.trust_expired: The gateway or saved connection changed while this confirmation was open. Restart setup to review the current certificate.

init.title: Polling settings
init.description: This changes monitoring only. The mode toggles remain on until changed.

token_expiring.title: Enphase gateway token expires soon
token_expiring.description: The token expiry hint is {expiry}. If Remember credentials is enabled, the integration attempts renewal before expiry and retains the current token if the cloud service is unavailable. Otherwise, use Reconfigure to obtain or enter a replacement. Decoded dates are hints; the gateway validates the token.

certificate_changed.title: Review the gateway certificate
certificate_changed.description: The saved gateway certificate could not be verified. Connections are blocked and no replacement is trusted automatically. Use Reconfigure on Enphase IQ Battery Local Control, check the gateway address and advertised serial, and confirm the detected certificate only if you trust it.
